translation: In general, in treating disease, if one clearly knows the root and branch and treats according to the method, why must one consult the crowd? The Yin Yang Bie Lun (陰陽別論) says: Be careful and familiar with yin and yang; do not consult the crowd. The Biao Ben Bing Chuan Lun (標本病傳論) says: Know the root and know the branch, and ten thousand actions will be ten thousand correct; not to know the root and branch is called reckless action.
translator_notes: 陰陽別論/標本病傳論 kept as chapter names; 標本 rendered 'root and branch'.
